children: JBS announced a 50/50 joint venture with Viva to combine their leather production, processing and commercialization businesses into a new company named JBS Viva.
JBS S.A. and Viva Holding will each own 50% of JBS Viva; JBS S.A. will contribute JBS Couros quotas representing its leather division.
Parity governance: up to six directors (three appointed by each side); JBS names the chair and CFO, Viva names the CEO and COO.
Transaction includes leather production assets and Viva’s leather-related chemical manufacturing; several assets (e.g., collagen/gelatin, certain international plants, Cactus, Texas) are excluded.
Agreements include Leather Supply and Raw Material Supply pacts for hides to JBS Viva and return of trimmings/shavings to JBS for gelatin/collagen use; closing subject to customary conditions.
